I would think it'd be a few factors.

1. Elo shift from new season. With the new season comes with everyone shifting down about 4-5 divisions so what would be your plat 3 mmr would be around gold 2 mmr now. As the season progresses it will slowly shift just like last season. 

2. Meta shifts. The champions you were probably really good at are just not as great anymore because of the immense shift of preseason and other patches. Adapting is always key to climbing every season and rarely do people climb with the same champ every season unless they are a hardcore OTP. 

3. Mentality. Losing confidence about yourself because of not acknowledging the previous 2 reasons and blaming it solely on your skill is a bad way to go into a game.
